messages:
noah_sales: FYI - Sunrise Bank procurement wants a POC assurance packet. They asked specifically for SOC 2 Type II evidence, an ISO snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation. Need by COB Friday for their vendor review.

anya_se: We can pull the redacted SOC2 and ISO cert. For pen-test they only want an attestation + remediation summary, not the raw report. Good to confirm who signs.

maya_compliance: I can produce a one-page attestation and an index of artifacts. Questions: 1) do they require engagement dates in the attestation? 2) any special language around KMS/export? Legal needs to sign off on wording. I can deliver a draft in <24h if we have remediation notes.

viktor_engineering: Add this line about Private deployment/KMS: `Customer-managed keys remain within the customer VPC; Redwood does not export or hold private keys.` Also include: `Audit logs retained per customer config; export on request.` I'll attach a simple SVG.

noah_sales: Procurement also asked whether Dedicated trial pricing differs from hosted for POCs. Keep it simple: "Dedicated trial pricing is available on request; contact your Redwood rep for terms."

maya_compliance: Draft attestation: [Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that a third-party penetration test (ForgeSec) covering the Redwood inference control plane was completed on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]. The full report is controlled; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference - Compliance

opsbot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-4488 assigned to maya_compliance. Due 1916239999.

maya_compliance: I'll stage a presigned packet with: SOC2_redacted.pdf, ISO27001_scan.jpg, Attestation_draft.pdf (pending legal), Remediation_summary.pdf, Arch_diagram.svg, Pricing_note.txt, Telemetry_line.txt. Link will expire in 7 days.

anya_se: Procurement DM: they do NOT need full report, only attestation + summary + arch diagram. Good to proceed.

maya_compliance: Uploading now to secure presign. Presign link (internal): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-4488/sunrise-poc-packet.zip?exp=7d (do not share externally).

noah_sales: I'll forward the presigned link to Sunrise procurement and confirm if legal signature is required before download. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
